images.name: 청석 파월
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a brand-new high-fantasy MMORPG weapon design, ONE SINGLE COMPLETE LONGBOW ONLY. Portrait 1024x1536 canvas, 2:3 aspect ratio. Show one large upright bow near-front with a very slight three-quarter angle, filling 85–90% of image height, with 5–8% empty margin above the top tip and below the bottom tip. Keep every limb tip fully inside the image. Clean solid near-black midnight background. No text, labels, typography, watermarks, borders, panels, inset views, second bow, arrows, people, hands, swords, staffs or other objects.
Design theme: Twilight of the Blue Moon, noble luminous blue. Deep cobalt moonstone, clear crystalline azure, translucent pearl-blue lunar material, rich opaline blue surfaces dominate the physical construction. Only restrained fine pale platinum or antique-gold joining lines; not grey steel painted blue. A clearly visible blue moon is physically integrated into the silhouette near the central grip, with airy negative spaces, but no oversized circular lump. Functional identifiable long recurve limbs, a comfortable central grip and ONE thin taut bowstring linking upper and lower limb tips. Elegant asymmetric extravagance and disciplined coherent construction, not arbitrary sword pieces glued to a bow. Full-length luxury concept art with crisp highly detailed surfaces, beautiful material depth and restrained edge illumination, no giant halo, no smoke or scenery. The single bow is an elegant layered bow of fractured blue moonstone. Three broad overlapping asymmetrical curved crystal strata flow along each long recurve limb, with different offsets and open slits; smooth graceful overall arc despite irregular chipped inner edges. A broken yet unmistakable luminous BLUE crescent is integrated beside the central grip, its two unequal ends flowing naturally into the limbs. Upper limb is long and sweeping; lower limb has a shorter double-return curve. Tiny crystal breaks are structural details, not detached debris. Sophisticated long-limbed proportions.

visualqa.note: 층진 청석 파편을 긴 활대에 통합한 비대칭 실루엣. 중앙 푸른 초승달, 손잡이와 단일 활줄, 상하 끝 모두 확인.
